title: `getOperatorPowerAt` uses current prices for past stake calculations
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  `OBaseMiddlewareReader::getOperatorPowerAt()` is trying to calculate the stake power that a specific operator had at a past timestamp based on their stake across all active vaults. This past stake power is used to sort the operator against others in `sortOperatorsByPower`, and also in `ODefaultOperatorRewards::_getRewardsAmountPerVault` to determine how the `stakerAmount` will be distributed among their active shared vaults. ```solidity     function _getRewardsAmountPerVault(         address[] memory operatorVaults,
